observed_behavior: A state written after Candidate preimage validation can be overwritten by commit and then deleted or replaced by failure rollback.
expected_behavior: Each commit and rollback action is conditional on exact validated or apply-owned bytes; a mismatch preserves the later state and yields zero committed paths.
impact: Concurrent or external repository state can be lost, violating the zero-commit and retriable guarantees of AC-013 and BDD-013.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: The inserted later state remains byte-identical after the forced apply failure.
steps: Seal one create Candidate in an isolated repository.
Insert a different target state after preimage validation and before the first canonical replacement.
Trigger the existing after-replace failure boundary and inspect the target after rollback.
reproduction.sample: The deterministic case injected one later state, returned PROMOTION_FAILED, and left the target absent instead of preserving those bytes.

root_cause.summary: The apply loop has a precheck-to-replace gap and _rollback restores or removes targets without confirming that current bytes are still the apply-owned postimage.

next_action: Implementation executor adds commit-mismatch and rollback-later-state regression reds, implements conditional commit and rollback, then reruns recovery, BDD-013, Windows/Linux full verification and fresh review.
